import unittest


def strlen(string: str) -> int:
    return len(string)


# Unit test for function strlen

    assert strlen("") == 0
    assert strlen("x") == 1
    assert strlen("abc") == 3
    assert strlen("hello world") == 11
    assert strlen("a b c") == 5

    assert strlen("\n\t") == 2

    assert strlen("😀😀") == 2  # emoji counted as characters

if __name__ == "__main__":

def test_strlen():

    assert strlen("") == 0

    # Single character
    assert strlen("a") == 1

    # Typical string
    assert strlen("hello") == 5

    # String with spaces
    assert strlen("hello world") == 11

    # Leading/trailing spaces count
    assert strlen("  hi  ") == 6

    # Unicode characters
    assert strlen("héllo") == 5
    assert strlen("日本語") == 3

    # Digits and special characters
    assert strlen("12345!@#$%") == 10

    # Newlines and tabs count as characters
    assert strlen("a\nb\tc") == 5

    # Long string
